headline: Fireworks AI breach exposes Notion chat transcripts and Uber driver data
summary: AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI disclosed a new breach, its second in as many months, after attackers accessed its systems via a compromised cloud provider. The breach exposed Notion's AI chat transcripts in a small number of workspaces and let hackers steal drivers' license information Uber had stored with Fireworks.
